Material Symbols (Rounded, weight 400, 24dp), Android vector drawables taken from
https://github.com/google/material-design-icons (symbols/android/<name>/materialsymbolsrounded/<name>_24px.xml),
with only the `android:tint` attribute removed. Licensed under the Apache License 2.0, see ../licenses/apache-2.0.txt.
Bundled at app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_*.xml, except ic_notification.xml, which belongs to this project.
